project: Namias Portfolio - Smart Caching Performance Optimization
summary: Implement a comprehensive multi-layer caching strategy for the Namias portfolio to achieve sub-100ms TTFB, instant navigation, and offline resilience. This PRD covers server-side caching (in-memory, Upstash Redis, CDN), client-side caching (SWR, localStorage, service worker), static page optimization (ISR, SSG, pre-rendering), and media/image caching — all with measurable performance targets and monitoring.
narrative: The Namias portfolio is a Next.js 16 App Router site with Sanity CMS, 6 API routes, 50+ components, and Cal.com/Umami third-party integrations. While the site already uses SWR for client-side data fetching and SSG for blog pages, there is no systematic caching strategy. Content from Sanity is fetched fresh on every render, API responses lack cache headers, static pages are regenerated on every deploy, and there's no in-memory cache layer. This PRD introduces a multi-tier caching architecture: L1 (in-memory TTL cache for CMS data), L2 (Upstash Redis for API response caching), L3 (CDN edge cache via Vercel), and L4 (browser cache via service worker and SWR). Each layer has configured TTLs, invalidation strategies, and monitoring.
principles: Cache everything — every response should have an explicit Cache-Control strategy.
Stale-while-revalidate — serve stale content instantly while fetching fresh data in the background.
Tag-based invalidation — Sanity webhooks trigger targeted cache purges by content type.
Measurable targets — every caching layer has a performance target (TTFB, cache hit rate, time-to-interactive).
No behaviour change — caching must be transparent to users and not change any visible behaviour.
Offline first — service worker caches critical assets for instant repeat visits.
Each cache layer is a commit — infrastructure, implementation, and verification each get their own commit.

epics.title: Cache strategy & infrastructure
epics.summary: Audit current caching state, define the multi-layer architecture, create cache utility library with TTL support, and document the strategy.

stories.title: Create caching PRD and strategy document
stories.details: Write prd.json with caching plan. Create docs/performance/caching-strategy.md defining L1-L4 cache layers, TTL values, invalidation triggers, and performance targets.

stories.title: Audit current caching state
stories.details: Inventory all pages, API routes, and data fetches. Document current Cache-Control headers, SWR config, revalidation settings. Measure baseline TTFB, cache hit rates, and Lighthouse scores.

stories.title: Create cache utility library with TTL and stale-while-revalidate
stories.details: Create src/lib/cache.ts with: TTL-based in-memory cache, stale-while-revalidate pattern, cache key generation with tag prefix, bulk invalidation by tag, and optional Upstash Redis backend.

stories.title: Add cache configuration to env.example
stories.details: Add CACHE_TTL_DEFAULT, CACHE_TTL_STALE, REDIS_CACHE_URL, REDIS_CACHE_TOKEN to .env.example. Document cache env vars.

epics.title: Sanity CMS data caching
epics.summary: Implement multi-layer caching for Sanity CMS content: in-memory TTL cache (L1), CDN-aware fetch with SWR (L2), tag-based webhook invalidation, and stale-while-revalidate patterns.

stories.title: Wrap CMS content fetcher with in-memory cache
stories.details: Update src/lib/cms-content.server.ts to use the cache utility. Cache all CMS queries with TTL=300s. Serve stale content while revalidating in background. Add cache tags per content type.

stories.title: Add Sanity CDN cache headers and use CDN API
stories.details: Ensure Sanity client uses CDN URL for read queries. Add perspective=published for public queries. Configure @sanity/client with useCdn=true.

stories.title: Implement tag-based webhook cache invalidation
stories.details: Update webhook route to accept Sanity tag-based invalidation. Parse webhook payload for document type/ID, build cache tags, and invalidate matching cache entries.

stories.title: Add stale-while-revalidate headers to CMS data responses
stories.details: Add Cache-Control: stale-while-revalidate=60 to all CMS data fetches. Ensure SWR period is 60s with max-age of 300s.

stories.title: Reduce SWR revalidation frequency on client components
stories.details: Update all useSWR hooks with dedupingInterval=5000, revalidateIfStale=true, revalidateOnFocus=false. Add errorRetryCount=2 and errorRetryInterval=10000.

epics.title: API route caching
epics.summary: Add cache headers to all API route responses: CDN caching for GET endpoints, Redis response caching, conditional requests with ETags, and cache tagging for targeted invalidation.

stories.title: Add Cache-Control headers to GET /api/resume
stories.details: Add public, max-age=300, stale-while-revalidate=60, s-maxage=600 to /api/resume. Add ETag based on resume URL hash.

stories.title: Add cache headers to /api/media/[...path]
stories.details: Add public, max-age=31536000, immutable for media assets. Add CDN-Cache: hit for cached assets.

stories.title: Add cache headers to /api/chat health endpoint
stories.details: Add no-cache for POST /api/chat but public, max-age=60 for GET health check. Add Surrogate-Control header for edge caching.

stories.title: Add cache headers to /api/sanity/live
stories.details: Add no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate for live/preview endpoints.

stories.title: Implement Upstash Redis response caching for API routes
stories.details: Create src/lib/api-cache.ts with Redis-backed response caching. Cache GET responses with configurable TTL per route. Fall back to in-memory if Redis unavailable.

stories.title: Add cache tags and conditional requests
stories.details: Add ETag headers to all GET API responses. Handle If-None-Match returning 304. Add Cache-Tag header for CDN-based invalidation.

epics.title: Static page & ISR optimization
epics.summary: Optimize static page generation: ISR for blog pages with content-based revalidation, SSG for all static pages, pre-render critical pages at build time, and add Cache-Control headers to all static assets.

stories.title: Add ISR revalidation to blog pages with on-demand revalidation
stories.details: Add revalidate=3600 to blog/[slug]/page.tsx. Implement on-demand revalidation via webhook for individual posts. Add generateStaticParams with all published slugs.

stories.title: Add static generation to project pages with content-based revalidation
stories.details: Create generateStaticParams for project pages. Add revalidate=3600. Wire project content mutations into webhook-based revalidation.

stories.title: Add Cache-Control headers for static assets in next.config.js
stories.details: Add Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable for _next/static/* assets. Add Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600, s-maxage=86400 for pages.

stories.title: Pre-render all static pages at build time with generateStaticParams
stories.details: Add generateStaticParams to all dynamic routes. Ensure blog/[slug], project/[slug], and any other dynamic routes are pre-rendered at build time.

stories.title: Optimize metadata and font caching
stories.details: Add Cache-Control headers for fonts. Optimize metadata generation with cached queries. Add preconnect hints for third-party origins.

epics.title: Client-side caching & instant navigation
epics.summary: Optimize client-side data fetching with SWR configuration, implement localStorage cache for Sanity data, add route prefetching for critical pages, and create a service worker for offline asset caching.

stories.title: Create global SWR configuration with sensible defaults
stories.details: Create src/lib/swr-config.tsx with SWRConfig provider: dedupingInterval=5000, revalidateIfStale=true, revalidateOnFocus=false, errorRetryCount=2, keepPreviousData=true.

stories.title: Implement localStorage cache for non-critical Sanity data
stories.details: Create src/lib/local-cache.ts with localStorage-backed cache for Sanity content. Cache keyed by content type. TTL=3600s. Used for non-critical UI data.

stories.title: Add route prefetching for critical pages
stories.details: Add Link prefetch to navigation links for critical pages. Add IntersectionObserver-based prefetching for visible links.

stories.title: Create service worker for offline asset caching
stories.details: Create public/sw.js with: cache-first for static assets, network-first for API routes, stale-while-revalidate for Sanity content. Register service worker in layout.

stories.title: Add prefetch and preconnect hints to document head
stories.details: Add dns-prefetch for Sanity CDN, Umami, Google Fonts, Cal.com. Add preconnect with crossorigin for critical origins. Add preload for above-the-fold assets.

epics.title: Image & media caching optimization

stories.title: Add immutable cache headers to media gateway responses
stories.details: Add Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable to /api/media/[...path]. Add ETag based on signature. Return 304 when ETag matches.

stories.title: Optimize Sanity image URLs with CDN parameters
stories.details: Update src/lib/sanity.image.ts to add auto=format and q=80 to all Sanity image URLs. Add width/height attributes. Generate blur hash placeholders.

stories.title: Add lazy loading and fetchpriority attributes to images
stories.details: Add loading=lazy to below-the-fold images. Add fetchpriority=high to hero/LCP images. Add decoding=async to all images.

epics.title: CDN & edge cache configuration

stories.details: Audit every response. Create a cache header matrix: page type, cache status, max-age, s-maxage, stale-while-revalidate, private/public. Standardize all responses.
